name: What kind of data does an AI-Ready website utilize?

mainEntity.name: What kind of data does an AI-Ready website utilize?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI-Ready website utilizes a broad range of data to function effectively. This includes user behavior data (clicks, dwell time, navigation paths), demographic information (if collected and consented), purchase history, search queries, content interactions, and technical data (device type, location). This data is often structured and processed by AI algorithms to generate insights, personalize experiences, and automate various marketing and operational tasks.
acceptedAnswer.description: It utilizes user behavior, demographic, purchase history, search query, content interaction, and technical data, processed by AI for insights and personalization.
